# Fly Skins — palettes for the DeepSeek Harness web UI

Four light/dark palettes for the official DeepSeek Harness web UI, a cyan scanline that runs only
wh
ile the model works, and a HUD sidebar.
**四套明暗配色、只在模型运行时出现的青色扫描线，以及 HUD 侧栏。**
`@dsh-fly/dsh-plugin-fly-skins` · category **theme** · MIT

> **Preview data.** The screenshots below are the official DeepSeek Harness UI with this skin
> inst

alled — no Fly workbench, fresh profile. Workspaces and sessions are sample or blank-profile
> data

(example names include `atlas-web`, `billing-api`, `infra-notes`); the sidebar crop shows a
> blank

default workspace. No real conversations appear.
>
> **预览数据**：下面的截图是官方 DeepSeek Harness UI + 本皮肤（没有

Fly 工作台、全新 profile）。
> 工作区/会话是示例或空白 profile 数据（示例名包括 `atlas-web` / `billing-api` / `infra-notes`），
>
侧栏截图显示的是空白默认工作区；不含任何真实会话。
## Four palettes
| Palette | id | Look | Pick it when |

| **Solid** | `solid` | Opaque panels, crisp borders | You want a flat, high-contrast room |
| **Gla

ss** | `glass` | Translucent frosted surfaces, hairline edges | You want depth without colour |
| **

Volume** | `volume` | Glass volume + state glow + text plates | You want the lit, sculpted read |
|
**Neon** | `neon` | Scene light field + edge glow + text plates + dark-half running scan | You want
the scene-light field (default in dsh-fly) |

Every palette has a light and a dark half. The choice persists in the profile's patch layer
(field `
skin`), so it survives restarts and profile switches.
**四套配色各有明暗两半**，选择写进 profile 的 patch 层（`skin` 字段），重启和切换 profile 后保留。
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Or add it from **Settings → Plugins** in the harness UI, then **restart** the app — the engine
cache
s client bundles in-process, so a page refresh is not enough.
Once installed, the palette picker appears as its own row in **Settings → General**:

It works standalone: install the skin without the Fly workbench and you get the official UI in
Fly c

olours; install the workbench without the skin and you get the official look plus the
workbench.
**独立可用**：不装 Fly 工作台也有官方 UI 的 Fly 配色；只装工作台不装皮肤则是官方外观 + 工作台。
## Features
### Scene light field

Neon paints a scene light field behind the whole window: deep navy canvas, a 46px circuit grid
runni

ng edge to edge, cyan edge glow bleeding out of the rail card, and text sitting on its own
plate so

it stays sharp over the field. Dark and light are two halves of one recipe, not two
themes.

**霓虹在整窗画一张场景光场**：深蓝画布 + 46px 电路网格、栏卡外溢青光、文字坐字座；明暗两半是同一套
配方的两个半区。
### Running scanline

In the neon dark half, when a turn is running, a **2px** cyan line sweeps bottom-to-top through
the

conversation column, trailing a **48px** glow in the same cyan as the todo panel's ring
(`rgba(53, 2

11, 224, 0.78)`, T10). It is tied to the harness's own running marker
(`data-chat-running`): the lin

e exists only while the model is working and is gone the moment the
turn settles. It is a background

layer — it does not paint over glyphs — but it can show through
transparent gaps in text and surfac

es; idle reading never gets a moving line. Off under
`prefers-reduced-motion` and at ≤768px.

**模型工作时才扫**：2px 青线自下而上扫过中列，尾迹 48px、与 Todo 任务列表卡 T10 同色
`rgba(53,211,224,.78)`。线挂在引擎自己的 `data-chat-ru

nning` 上，模型一停就消失；它画在背景层、
不盖字形，但会从文字/表面的透明缝隙透出来；静态翻阅不扫。`prefers-reduced-motion` 与 ≤768px
下关闭。
### HUD sidebar

Workspace folders are a cyan HUD badge: pending cyan (`#35d3e0` dark / `#0f6f7d` light),
**13px**, w

eight 600, 0.12em tracking, uppercase Latin, with the folder icon in the same cyan and
a 1px trailin

g gradient rule. The row keeps the upstream surface — no extra plate or bar. Session
rows are unchan

ged: 17.5px white 400 with the pill selection. 13px is deliberate: 14px clipped
`DEFAULT WORKSPACE`

to `DEFAULT WORKSP…` in the 280px rail, so the badge keeps the full label one
step below the session

FAULT WORKSP…` in the 280px rail, so the badge keeps the full label one
step below the session type.

**侧栏工作区文件夹是青色 HUD 标牌**：pending 青（深色 `#35d3e0` / 浅色 `#0f6f7d`）、13px、600、
0.12em 字距、英文大写，文件夹图标同色，右侧一条

1px 渐隐尾线；行本身没有额外底板/色条。会话行不动：
17.5px 白字 400 + 胶囊选中态。13px 是有意的：14px 会把 `DEFAULT WORKSPACE` 截成
`DEFAULT
WORKSP…`（280px 轨道实测），所以保留完整标签，只比会话行低一档。
### Type

Latin is MiSans Latin, embedded (~166KB, Apache-2.0, three weights) so the chrome keeps its HUD
voic

e offline; Chinese falls back to your own font setting. Buttons and panel titles take 600
weight wit

h 0.04em tracking, section labels 500, numerals are tabular, and timestamps/counts
switch to the mon

o stack. Sidebar text is 125% (14→17.5px); the HUD workspace badge is the 13px
exception above. MiSa

ns Latin is scoped to neon; solid / glass / volume keep their shipped body
type and pixels, apart fr
om the shared 125% sidebar scale and the HUD workspace badge.

**字体**：拉丁用内置 MiSans Latin（~166KB，Apache-2.0，三档字重），中文回落用户字体；按钮/面板
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility
| Item | Value |

| Harness engine | `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.x` (verified on `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`) |
| Node | ≥

20 |
| Peer | `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` `^3.18.4` (the engine supplies the rest at load time) |

The package declares `dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client`: the host half contributes a loader row, a
boot-tim

e palette marker and the `flySkins` service; the client half contributes the token
override layer, t
he stylesheet and the settings UI.

**兼容性**：引擎 0.2.x（在 `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-rc.2` 验过）；Node ≥20；peer 只有
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`。包声明 `
dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client`。
